module rtlpp_10142 (clk, reset, X, Y); 

parameter word_size_in = 8; 
parameter word_size_out = 20; 

input clk, reset;
input signed [word_size_in-1:0] X;   
output signed [word_size_out-1:0] Y; 

reg signed [word_size_out-1:0] Y;

wire signed [word_size_in:0] x1;
assign x1 = X;

wire signed  [9:0] x_1;  
wire signed  [9:0] x1t;
wire signed  [11:0] x7;
wire signed  [12:0] x9;
wire signed  [11:0] x_4;
wire signed  [13:0] x_28;
wire signed  [14:0] x_36;
wire signed  [15:0] x105;
wire signed  [16:0] x210;
wire signed  [17:0] x256;

assign x_1 = -(x1<<0);
assign x1t = +(x1<<0);
assign x7 = +(x1<<3)-(x1<<0);

assign x_28 = -(x7<<2);
assign x_36 = -(x9<<2);
assign x105 = -(x7<<0)+(x7<<4);
assign x210 = +(x105<<1);
assign x256 = +(x1<<8);
